nodes.text: #252 : [ErGr80,p.62] [Er88c,p.102] number theory | irrationality This is known now for $1\leq k\leq 4$. The cases $k=1,2$ are reasonably straightforward, as observed by Erdős [Er52] . The case $k=3$ was proved independently by Schlage-Puchta [ScPu06] and Friedlander, Luca, and Stoiciu [FLC07] . The case $k=4$ was proved by Pratt [Pr22] . It is known that this sum is irrational for all $k\geq 1$ conditional on either Schinzel's conjecture (Schlage-Puchta [ScPu06] ) or Dickson's conjecture (Friedlander, Luca, and Stoiciu [FLC07] ). This is discussed in problem B14 of Guy's collection [Gu04] .
